topics.title: Introduction
topics.description: Start with the fundamentals of C++.

questions.question: What is C++?
answer: C++ is a compiled, general-purpose programming language that supports procedural, object-oriented and generic programming.

questions.question: What is the difference between C and C++?
answer: C focuses on procedural programming. C++ adds classes, templates, exceptions, RAII and a rich standard library.

topics.title: Inheritance
topics.description: Understand how classes can reuse and extend behavior.

questions.question: What is inheritance in C++?
answer: Inheritance lets a derived class reuse or extend the members of a base class.

questions.question: What are public, protected and private inheritance?
answer: Public inheritance preserves public and protected accessibility. Protected inheritance makes inherited public and protected members protected. Private inheritance makes them private in the derived class.

questions.question: What is function overloading?
answer: Multiple functions can share a name if their parameter lists differ. Return type alone cannot distinguish overloads.
questions.code:
int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
double add(double a, double b) { return a + b; }

topics.title: RAII
topics.description: Manage resources safely through object lifetime.

questions.question: What is RAII?
answer: Resource Acquisition Is Initialization ties resource ownership to object lifetime. A destructor releases the resource automatically, including during exception unwinding.
